releaseNotes: Prevents a non-responsive device identity read from delaying later ports.
An empty-identity port is deferred after the first bounded attempt during the primary P1-to-P8 pass.
The deferred port is retried afterward through the existing SerialCommandQueue only.

en: Added serial ISDU identity fallback probes for indexes 0x12, 0x13, and 0x10 with per-index diagnostics.
Improved Automation scenario selectors with black readable text and symbolic comparison operators.
ko: ICA 식별 분석을 위해 기존 직렬 ISDU 경로에서 0x12, 0x13, 0x10 인덱스 폴백 및 인덱스별 진단 로그를 추가했습니다.
시나리오 선택창의 기본 텍스트를 검정색으로 개선하고 비교 조건을 ≥, ≤, >, < 기호로 표시합니다.
